info.title: hauswart API
info.description: Versioned JSON API of hauswart, used by the web app, the mobile app and integrations. Errors share one envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Cookie-authenticated requests that change state must send an `Origin` header equal to the app origin and `Content-Type: application/json`; bearer requests are exempt.

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still open
get.description: `needsSetup` is true until the first administrator account exists. `tokenRequired` is true while setup is open and the server was started with `HAUSWART_SETUP_TOKEN`: the setup request must then carry `setupToken`.

post.summary: Create the first administrator and sign in
post.description: Only works while no user exists (409 `setup_complete` afterwards). When the server runs with `HAUSWART_SETUP_TOKEN`, `setupToken` must match it (403 `forbidden`). Starts a browser session (sets the session cookie).

post.summary: Sign in with a username and password
post.description: Starts a browser session (sets the session cookie). Failed attempts are rate limited per user and client address.

get.summary: The calling user, how they authenticated and their effective scopes

patch.summary: Update the calling user's display name or language

post.summary: Exchange a username and password for a device token
post.description: Issues a `mobile` bearer token (scopes read, write, docs:write, costs:write; valid for 90 days). The token is shown once. Failed attempts share the login rate limit.

delete.summary: Revoke the token used for this request

get.summary: List the calling user's API tokens
get.description: Never includes token values or hashes.

post.summary: Create an API token for an integration
post.description: The plaintext token is in the response and never shown again. Scopes cannot exceed the caller's own.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the calling user's API tokens
delete.description: Other users' tokens are not visible: 404.

patch.summary: Change a user's role, name, cost share or password
patch.description: A password reset ends the user's sessions and revokes all of their live API tokens. Demoting an administrator revokes their tokens that hold the `admin` scope. The last administrator cannot be demoted.

post.summary: Revoke all of a user's API tokens
post.description: Revokes every live API token (mobile, integration, MCP) of the user, e.g. after a leaked token. Browser sessions are not affected. Returns how many tokens were revoked.

cookieAuth.name: hauswart_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session cookie set by login or setup.

bearerAuth.description: API token (`hw_...`) from `POST /api/v1/auth/token` or `POST /api/v1/tokens`. Listed scopes are required.
